  8. Ruling reference 600016228

    Description
    A 30mm recoilless disruptor used for rendering medium sized IEDs (Improvised Explosive Device) safe that can either be mounted on a flexible stand or held by a Bomb Disposal Robot. Powered by an electrically initiated cartridge, the key components within an IED are then separated by injecting a column of water at high pressure. Machined from billets or lengths of stainless steel bar stock of high strength heat treated stainless steel, different styles of cartridge can be accommodated due to an interchangeable breach. This includes aluminium cartridges and 0.50 calibre cartridges. Packed in kit form in a foam lined rigid case which includes cleaning and maintenance tools, and other accessories, the product requires some assembly and preparation before use. Packed into an outer cardboard box.

  9. Ruling reference 600016950

    Description
    Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3 – 2018 specification Evolution competition car. Constructed in 2018 as a factory-developed GT3 specification racing car. The vehicle was designed and manufactured specifically for international motor racing under the FIA GT3 technical regulations. It is not a road-going Nissan GT-R subsequently modified for competition. The chassis forms part of the specialist Nissan/NISMO GT3 competition programme and was constructed as a purpose-built racing vehicle incorporating competition-specific chassis, suspension, braking, aerodynamic, safety, transmission, engine installation and electronic systems. The vehicle has no normal road or utility purpose and was designed, built and used solely as a competition motor vehicle. The Vehicle will be solely used for special events. The Vehicle is in their original state, without substantial changes to the chassis, body, steering, braking, transmission or suspension system, engine, wings etc.

  11. Ruling reference 600016389

    Description
    The product is an Aircraft Autobrake/Antiskid Control Box. It is an electronic control unit of less than 1000v which is installed in a Boeing 767 aircraft. The unit consists of an enclosed electronic assembly incorporating printed circuit boards, connectors, relays, switching and control apparatus. It receives signals from aircraft braking and wheel speed systems and processes those signals to control autobrake and anti-skid braking functions during aircraft landing and rejected take-off operations. The principal function of the unit is as the electrical control and monitoring apparatus for the braking system. It is not a numerical control panel and does not have a built-in automatic data-processing machine.

  20. Ruling reference 600016674

    Description
    A dining table, circa 1955, by the French designer Jean Royère. The table is crafted from stained oak-veneered wood, stained oak, glass, cane, painted wood, and brass. The tabletop features a cane-inlaid motif protected by a glass cover which enhances the detail of the pattern. The four tapered legs are finished with brass cuffs and decorative rods converging at a central brass ball. Measuring 76.5 x 370.2 x 110 cm, when fully extended the table was originally commissioned by a family in Lebanon. The balanced proportions, fine joinery, and mixtures of materials demonstrate Royère’s craftsmanship. The table is documented in publications, including Jean Royère by Pierre-Emmanuel Martin-Vivier (Norma Editions, 2002 and 2017), where it is photographed in its original setting.
